reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Alaska
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate residential landlords generally?
*/

% -----------------------
% Scenario (question) facts
% -----------------------

scenario_state(alaska).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The scenario statement is satisfied when the encoded question context holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(alaska),
    scenario_focus_year(2021).

% -----------------------
% Statute translations (Alaska Statutes, 2021)
% -----------------------

/*
  AK Stat  34.03.360 (2021) - Definitions for "this chapter"
  Key idea for this question: the chapter is about residential "dwelling units"
  and defines "landlord" broadly (owner/lessor/sublessor/manager).
*/

%  34.03.360(3): "dwelling unit" used as home/residence/sleeping place; includes mobile homes.
statute_ak_34_03_360_dwelling_unit_is_residential(alaska, 2021).

%  34.03.360(11): "landlord" means owner/lessor/sublessor; also manager in specified case.
statute_ak_34_03_360_defines_landlord_broadly(alaska, 2021).

%  34.03.360(19): "rental agreement" means agreements (written/oral) + valid rules/regulations.
statute_ak_34_03_360_defines_rental_agreement(alaska, 2021).

% Convenience: the chapter explicitly addresses residential landlord-tenant relationships.
statute_ak_34_03_chapter_is_residential_landlord_tenant_law(alaska, 2021) :-
    statute_ak_34_03_360_dwelling_unit_is_residential(alaska, 2021),
    statute_ak_34_03_360_defines_landlord_broadly(alaska, 2021),
    statute_ak_34_03_360_defines_rental_agreement(alaska, 2021).


/*
  AK Stat  34.03.040 (2021) - Prohibited provisions in rental agreements
  (a) A rental agreement may not provide that the tenant or landlord:
      (1) waives/foregoes rights/remedies under this chapter;
      (2) authorizes confession of judgment;
      (3) exculpation/limitation of liability or indemnify for that liability/costs;
      (4) agrees to pay the landlord's attorney fees.
  (b) prohibited provision is unenforceable; willful use -> other party may recover actual damages.
  (c) additional limits for mobile home parks (not necessary to answer "generally").
*/

%  34.03.040(a): prohibited rental agreement term categories (general rental agreements).
statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term(alaska, 2021, waive_or_forego_chapter_rights).
statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term(alaska, 2021, confess_judgment).
statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term(alaska, 2021, exculpate_or_limit_liability_or_indemnify).
statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term(alaska, 2021, tenant_agrees_to_pay_landlord_attorney_fees).

%  34.03.040(b): prohibited provisions are unenforceable.
statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term_unenforceable(alaska, 2021, Term) :-
    statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term(alaska, 2021, Term).

%  34.03.040(b): willful use of agreement containing known prohibited terms -> other party may recover actual damages.
statute_ak_34_03_040_willful_use_allows_actual_damages(alaska, 2021).

% This statute is an explicit regulation of what landlords (and tenants) may put in residential rental agreements.
statute_ak_34_03_040_is_explicit_landlord_regulation(alaska, 2021) :-
    statute_ak_34_03_chapter_is_residential_landlord_tenant_law(alaska, 2021),
    statute_ak_34_03_040_prohibited_term(alaska, 2021, _).


/*
  AK Stat  34.03.225 (2021) - Mobile home park operator eviction limits
  Encoded for completeness; it is eviction-specific but narrower than "landlords generally".
*/

%  34.03.225(a): operator may evict only for specified reasons.
statute_ak_34_03_225_mobile_home_eviction_ground(alaska, 2021, nonpayment_of_rent).
statute_ak_34_03_225_mobile_home_eviction_ground(alaska, 2021, continuing_conviction_based_violation_detrimental_to_health_safety_welfare).
statute_ak_34_03_225_mobile_home_eviction_ground(alaska, 2021, violation_of_enforceable_rental_agreement_term_not_prohibited_by_law).
statute_ak_34_03_225_mobile_home_eviction_ground(alaska, 2021, change_in_use_of_land_with_notice_constraints).

%  34.03.225(b): cannot evict due to age of mobile home except limited conditions (modeled at a high level).
statute_ak_34_03_225_prohibits_eviction_due_to_age_of_mobile_home(alaska, 2021).

%  34.03.225(c): notice to quit under AS 09.45.100-09.45.105 satisfies notice requirement (high level).
statute_ak_34_03_225_notice_to_quit_satisfies_notice_requirement(alaska, 2021).


% -----------------------
% Reasoning layer: answer the question from encoded statutes
% -----------------------

% "Explicitly regulate residential landlords generally" is satisfied if:
%  - the state's residential landlord-tenant chapter defines/targets landlords and dwelling units, AND
%  - there is at least one general (not merely niche) statutory restriction/duty directed at landlords in that residential context.
explicitly_regulates_residential_landlords_generally(State, Year) :-
    statute_ak_34_03_chapter_is_residential_landlord_tenant_law(State, Year),
    statute_ak_34_03_040_is_explicit_landlord_regulation(State, Year).

% -----------------------
% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
% -----------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    (   explicitly_regulates_residential_landlords_generally(State, Year)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

% -----------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate residential landlords generally?
